quote: We consider three metrics: (1) Bleu for sentence quality, (2) Accuracy for conditional generation capability. The accuracy is assessed by an oracle classifier to correctly predict the attributes that generated sentences are conditioned on. (3) G-score is reported as the geometric mean of Accuracy and Bleu.

We use perplexity (PPL) for language modeling, BLEU for generation quality, G-score (geometric mean of Accuracy and BLEU), Self‑BLEU for diversity, and also report Active units (AU) and Mutual Information (MI) as representation metrics.
